hero.title: Our projects
hero.subtitle: Discover the business platforms designed and engineered by DigitalPro Systems IT.

medoc.intro: Medoc was built to address the operational constraints of pharmacies and pharmaceutical wholesalers: real-time stock tracking, expiry date management and batch traceability. Before the solution was deployed, stock management relied largely on manual records, a frequent source of errors and stock-outs.
medoc.chartCaption: Before / after comparison following production rollout (illustrative figures — replace with your real data).
medoc.outro: Result: an operations team spending less time on manual entry and checks, and better product availability on the shelves. The solution keeps evolving with expiry-alert and automatic reordering modules.

dps-pos.intro: DPS-POS is a point-of-sale solution designed for high-volume retail environments. The goal: streamline checkout, reduce input errors, and give real-time visibility into store activity.
dps-pos.chartCaption: Before / after comparison following production rollout (illustrative figures — replace with your real data).
dps-pos.outro: Result: shorter queues, a calmer checkout team, and reliable sales reports available instantly for management. The solution integrates with the DPS-Invoice module for unified accounting.

dps-invoice.intro: DPS-Invoice automates invoice creation, delivery and tracking for sales and accounting teams. Before it was deployed, each invoice required several manual approvals and spreadsheet-based tracking, slowing down the billing cycle.
dps-invoice.chartCaption: Before / after comparison following production rollout (illustrative figures — replace with your real data).
dps-invoice.outro: Result: a significantly shorter billing cycle, fewer disputes caused by input errors, and better visibility into upcoming cash inflows for the finance team.
